newsitem.title: FINLAND: Trendless Helsinki slips to lower close.
newsitem.headline: Trendless Helsinki slips to lower close.

text.p: Shares coasted to a lower close in thin, trendless trade on Friday, with bearish Wall Street sentiment leading amid pre-weekend listlessness and little domestic impetus as the reporting season finished, brokers said.
The HEX index slipped 0.51 percent to 2236.30. Volume was sparse at 282 million markka.
Food and feed group Raisio stood out in a dull market, adding 3.50 markka to close at 310.00 after Thurday's briefing on the firm's cholesterol-reducing margarine wetted apetites.
Briskly traded Raisio made up 22 percent of total volume.
Construction group Polar gained 0.45 markka to 7.25 after a new capital restructuring programme eased doubts about the group's future, one broker said.
Banking group Merita eased 0.20 to close at 13.60, and telecom heavyweight Nokia shed 0.50 markka to 213.50 in steady trade amounting to a good fifth of total volume.
Brokers saw little inspiration ahead next week other than interim results due on Tuesday from Swedish Ericsson, Nokia's key European rival.
After that, eyes would turn to Nokia, due to report nine-month results on November 14, brokers said.
